rule_or_requirement: Pixel-only candidate should retain valid completion first and improve finished lap time against the selected pixel control.
observable_information: Frozen student posterior and inherited pixel-driver gas at inference, plus preregistered matched completion, lap, collision and action traces for evaluation.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Use the exact midpoint of inherited gas and 0.28 on posterior-approved eligible decisions; leave all other actions unchanged.
expected_success_endpoint: At least both control valid completion counts, zero invalid actions, at least 1,000 blended boosts and at least 2% paired lap gain when selected completion ties.
control: Frozen selected stable-risk pixel driver; original pixel student is a second matched risk reference with unchanged safe checkpoint.
falsifier: Candidate loses valid completion versus either reference, inactive blending, invalid actions or insufficient lap gain on a selected completion tie.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Three arms on tracks 1–3 × fresh seeds 5220–5223, 36 preregistered episodes.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU diagnostic capped at 1,800 seconds and 2,000 decisions per episode; no held-out, confirmation, blind, official or external action.
